description: Make the app global-ready: extract hardcoded strings, wire them to the i18n library (adding config/provider and package.json deps when missing), and translate every key into the target locales, writing locale files and code into the working tree. Same engine and result as `npx babelize translate`. Run babelize_analyze first; afterwards review `git diff` and run babelize_check. Requires a git repo with a clean working tree (commit or stash first; force: true overrides; dryRun: true previews without writing and works on a dirty tree). Incremental: a lockfile (.babelize/local/babelize-lock.json) means reruns only translate new or changed strings, and failed strings are retried on the next run. Earlier locales are kept and updated unless replace: true. Translation keys come from the MCP server environment, never from arguments: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY or OPENROUTER_API_KEY (your own LLM key), or a Babelize API key for Babelize-hosted translation (free tier): --api-key on this server, BABELIZE_API_KEY, or apiKey in .babelize/config.json. Returns files changed, per-locale translated/failed counts, failures with reasons, QA warnings, strings not wired into code, a diff summary (and a diff preview on dryRun). Sends progress notifications.

dryRun.description: Compute everything, write nothing; returns the diff summary and a preview. Still calls the translator (uses tokens).

force.description: Run on a dirty working tree (the result is then mixed with your uncommitted changes).

model.description: Model override for your own LLM key (not for babelize).

path.description: Project directory, relative to the workspace root (default: the workspace root). Must stay inside the workspace.

provider.description: Default: the first BYOK key found in the environment, then BABELIZE_API_KEY.

replace.description: Treat `to` as the full locale list: remove earlier locales not listed.

name: babelize_translate
title: Translate the project (local engine)
